falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically saw shallow retracements with no breakdown below initial support; a close sub-4950 would violate the structural floor and invalidate the bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for two consecutive sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The referenced bottom pattern featured VIX compression and rapid mean-reversion below 20; sustained elevated volatility would confirm this is not a bottom but rather a bear market rally continuation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield > 2Y yield by >10bps) and holds for 3+ sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with deeply inverted curves; an uninversion here would signal recession realization rather than soft-landing bottoming, breaking the macro analog

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
